args.reason: The --dry-run flag directly serves the first PRD goal (inspect current merge eligibility without risking a merge) and nothing beyond it: no history, storage or query surface. It reuses the existing floor reads, so the merge-floor logic stays the single source of truth, and the DoD covers both the merge-ok and blocked paths plus a test-double assertion that the GitHub merge call is never made. No over-scope and no unserved goal.
